paragraphs.text: Jolav was an aristocratic human from Urborg and the younger brother of Crovax . He had multiple sisters.

The embittered Jolav stayed behind on his family's estate when Crovax left to become a member of the Weatherlight crew and explore Dominaria . Crovax took with him the artifact that controlled the Windgrace family's guardian angel , Selenia . This allowed the Phyrexian creatures Morinfen and Gallowbraid to slaughter Jolav and the rest of Crovax's family. He had a strong jaw and shaved head like his father.
Jolav was featured in the comic -series Gerrard's Quest and "Born to Greatness."
